scope: Third additive exact-name botanical identity shard from the European GrapeGen registered-name to VIVC crosswalk. No synonym widening or legal origin permission is implied.

grapegen06-riesling-10077-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-riesling-10077-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen maps registered Riesling names to RIESLING WEISS, VIVC 10077. Welschriesling is explicitly a different VIVC identity and is not merged.

grapegen06-rkatsiteli-10116-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-rkatsiteli-10116-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen maps Georgian Rkatsiteli and registered spelling variants to RKATSITELI, VIVC 10116. The Adelaide exact source spelling is promoted only.

grapegen06-monastrell-7915-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-monastrell-7915-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen maps Spanish Monastrell to MONASTRELL, VIVC 7915. Mourvèdre appears as a separately registered synonym in the source, but no Adelaide Mourvèdre link is created here.

grapegen06-pinot-blanc-9272-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-pinot-blanc-9272-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen maps registered Pinot blanc names to PINOT BLANC, VIVC 9272. Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, and Chardonnay remain separate identities.

grapegen06-gamay-noir-4377-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-gamay-noir-4377-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen explicitly maps registered Gamay Noir to GAMAY NOIR, VIVC 4377. Teinturier Gamay identities are separately numbered and are not merged.

grapegen06-garnacha-blanca-4457-2026-09-.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-garnacha-blanca-4457-2026-09-.notes: GrapeGen maps Spanish Garnacha Blanca to GARNACHA BLANCA, VIVC 4457. This is not merged with Garnacha Tinta or other color variants.

grapegen06-garnacha-peluda-4460-2026-09-.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-garnacha-peluda-4460-2026-09-.notes: GrapeGen maps Spanish Garnacha Peluda to GARNACHA PELUDA, VIVC 4460. It remains distinct from VIVC 4461.

grapegen06-garnacha-tinta-4461-2026-09-0.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2B
grapegen06-garnacha-tinta-4461-2026-09-0.notes: GrapeGen explicitly maps Spanish Garnacha Tinta to GARNACHA TINTA, VIVC 4461. This resolves the Adelaide row directly; it does not create an Adelaide source-name link for Grenache.
